# Seth Hobson

> Seth Hobson is a software engineer with 15+ years of experience in applied AI, data engineering, and distributed systems. He is the founder of Major 7 Apps, creator of the wshobson/agents plugin marketplace, and author of the AI Primitives newsletter.

Currently Senior AI Engineer at United Data Technologies; previously senior software engineer at Apple (2015–2021) and Kuali (2021–2023).

Last updated: 2026-08-21

## Identity and expertise

- Public handle: `wshobson`
- Primary areas: agentic systems, applied AI, data engineering, distributed systems, software architecture, and Model Context Protocol tooling
- Known for: creating the wshobson/agents multi-harness plugin marketplace and founding the Major 7 Apps product studio

## Links

- [sethhobson.com](https://sethhobson.com/): personal site (this site)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wshobson): open-source work
- [Major 7 Apps](https://major7apps.com/): product studio — hub linking to all current applications
- [AI Primitives](https://primitivesai.substack.com/): weekly newsletter on applied AI, agentic systems, and engineering primitives
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wshobson): professional profile

## Projects and canonical sources

- [Agentic Plugin Marketplace overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/agents/): 92 plugins, 202 agents, 181 skills, and 105 commands; built for Claude Code and consumed natively by Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, and GitHub Copilot. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/agents)
- [Claude Code Slash Commands overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/commands/): 57 production-ready slash commands comprising 15 multi-agent workflows and 42 focused tools. [Source code](https://github.com/wshobson/commands)
- [Capital Companion](https://capitalcompanion.ai): AI-powered trading insights, stock analysis, and risk management
- [Pensyve overview](https://sethhobson.com/projects/pensyve/): universal memory runtime for AI agents with episodic, semantic, and procedural memory, 8-signal fusion retrieval, FSRS forgetting, and offline-first local operation. [Source code](https://github.com/major7apps/pensyve)
- [Maverick MCP](https://github.com/wshobson/maverick-mcp): personal stock-analysis MCP server
- [Tiingo MCP](https://github.com/major7apps/tiingo-mcp): production-grade MCP server for the Tiingo financial data API, 17 tools, on PyPI
